title: Todo list v2
description: A second todo reference app used to test LLP 0021 Phase 0-2: a richer row shape, a generated Contract binding surface with an extra mutation, Exact project checks for generated descriptors, a wrong-native-server-shape capability diagnostic, and an Exact-owned provider conformance fixture.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headless.toolchain: node>=22 (built-in fetch); cargo to build/run the local server

contract.browserRunner: SNAPBACK_TODO_V2_API=http://127.0.0.1:4421 bun run --cwd demos/todo-v2/surfaces/contract dev (Exact checkout = SNAPBACK_EXACT_ROOT or sibling ../exact; verified revision pinned in surfaces/contract/exact.pin.json)
contract.build: bun run --cwd demos/todo-v2/surfaces/contract build (vite build via the exactContractWeb preset -> surfaces/contract/dist/web/)

exact.toolchain: bun (to load Exact package exports from an install or local checkout)

react.note: React/Expo adapter is a capability gap in v0; the headless SnapbackClient is the framework-neutral core a React adapter would bind over.

headless: create/toggle/priority/delete mutations with server-owned system fields
realtime update reaches a second client
wrong native Exact server shape diagnostic (SNAPBACK_CAPABILITY_EXACT_NATIVE_ARTIFACTS_UNAVAILABLE)
contract: Exact project checks validate generated descriptor modules and row shapes
adapter rejected-mutation rollback republishes authoritative rows
adapter exposes one combined pending mutation count across runtime links and provider mutations
contract bindings resolve to generated Snapback descriptors
mounts against live backend; renders live snapshot
Contract action drives a Snapback mutation (optimistic update)
Contract actions toggle completion, change priority, and delete through Snapback mutations
mutation is server-authoritative and visible to headless surface (cross-surface)
provider seam subscribe + mutate on live backend
Exact-owned DataProvider conformance suite passes against the Snapback provider
runtime links include the generated setPriority mutation
no demo-local Contract sidecars are required

capabilityGaps: ibex_ctx_db_host_bridge (JS ctx.db handlers; v0 uses declarative HostPlans)
notClaiming: offline-first / local handler replay (this is an Online-class integration)
Partiful-scale throughput (this is a demo shape, not a benchmark)
JS handler execution (HostPlan declarative plans only in v0)
